title: Pure rapid-drainage compartment transmissivity source equation

source.behavior: Compute compartment water thickness from pore diameter and occupied pore-volume fraction, apply the configured power, scale by compartment thickness, apply SatFr only to the top compartment, and accumulate in source order.

scope: explicit typed scalar and array inputs, no global SWAP state
one rapid-drainage transmissivity profile term and its ordered total
physical geometry guards for finite positive thickness/diameter and pore_volume <= dz
100,000 deterministic bitwise comparisons at O0 and O2
non_goals: water-table/drainage-head response or drain capacity limitation
whole-column mass receipt, transaction/restart owner or production admission
